{"command":"python3 - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
import csv, io
bill='''record_id,quantity,unit_price,shipping
CUS-001,28,63.66,74
CUS-002,40,55.6,62
CUS-003,72,30.9,24
CUS-004,16,11.51,53
CUS-005,34,64.0,43
CUS-006,55,60.08,66
CUS-007,37,65.85,19
CUS-008,66,36.68,62
CUS-009,40,15.6,44
CUS-010,53,22.76,34
'''
d=Decimal('0.0837'); t=Decimal('0.0673')
q=Decimal('0.01')
tot=Decimal('0')
for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(bill)):
    x=Decimal(r['quantity'])*Decimal(r['unit_price'])*(1-d)*(1+t)+Decimal(r['shipping'])
    y=x.quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    print(r['record_id'], x, y)
    tot+=y
print(len(list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(bill)))), tot)
PY"}
